items.quote: Waleed Alasadi: ...So like a validation rule on a person account, you would set it up on the account object. / Cedrick Infantado: actually it would trigger the validation on the contacts as well / Kobi Kunasekaran: The record types I think are just in the account right now. / Cedrick Infantado: For for record types and you have to set it up for person accounts to manage on profiles.

items.quote: Waleed Alasadi: ...What is ready for review mean?... / Kobi Kunasekaran: it's work done. Uh it's essentially like internal UAT like somebody to check confirm let Wagertechknow and then move it to done. / Kobi Kunasekaran: ...everything that we migrated from asana that was like we also had like a uh jumper UAT status section. All of those went into ready for review....

gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ...you just need to confirm that we've let Wagertechknow and then move them to done and obviously make sure the functionality works.
gemini_disagreements.why: Gemini says WagerTech must confirm before Done. Kobi said the team must confirm it has told WagerTech (notification) and checked the functionality. The Summary line 'Migrated ticket statuses reviewed with upcoming user acceptance testing' also implies client UAT; the transcript says internal UAT.
